Our story

Our journey

Our foundation

Rooted in Andhra taste.
Grown in Vijayawada.

RR Durbar began with a family poultry business built around quality and hygiene. That care carried into RR Joints, and then into RR Durbar, where Andhra flavours are served in a royal setting.

Every plate still follows the same simple idea: honest food, made consistently, for the whole table.
